description: Keeps the tree between page loads: in localStorage and tree.json next to index.html. Saving also sends it to the local server (node/app.js), which writes tree.json to disk.

added.load(): Returns { tree, from }: from is 'localStorage' or 'disk'; both are null if nothing is saved. Async.
added.save(tree): Saves to localStorage and PUTs tree.json. Returns true if it reached the disk. Async.

2.notes: load() reads both localStorage and tree.json and keeps the one with the higher root seq (localStorage when equal), so a tree.json changed outside the browser wins.
